statement: Very-long-context (million-token) scalability remains unsolved within the Transformer-plus-compression paradigm. Eviction/quantization/low-rank methods are evaluated up to ~128K tokens; beyond that, accuracy degrades because models are less robust to sparse/quantized attention outside their effective context, and the retained subset or codebook cannot preserve all needles. Architectural alternatives (NHA's fixed m-slot memory, NSA's sparse blocks) bound exact retrieval by design. No retained method demonstrates lossless million-token single-needle and multi-needle retrieval under aggressive compression, leaving the scaling regime open.
